{{Quote|The Sleek Cruiser Inn on Grand Eucer Street. Room 2222. But let me assure you, my friend, this inn is no sleek cruiser. More like a garbage barge.|Didi Oddo to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
The '''Sleek Cruiser Inn''' was a dilapidated [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located on [[Grand Eucer Street]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. During the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], the thief [[Fligh]] stayed in [[Room 2222]] of the hotel, a fact discovered [[Didi Oddo]], who then passed the information on to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] along with a warning about the state of the hotel. Kenobi then traveled to the hotel in search of Fligh.<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
